brique._comment: Engine-native Reflexive family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: meaning.query
objective.description: Query the root meaning projection with filters, paging, and ordering.

#root.role: Run a root-only query against the projection database and return the matching projected elements.

element_kind._comment: Optional. Filter results to this element kind (e.g. capacity, matter, document).

ctx_id._comment: Optional. Restrict query to elements belonging to this context id (absolute path from /root).

ctx_mode._comment: Optional. Only meaningful together with ctx_id. Accepted values: strict (default — only elements whose ctx_id exactly equals the requested one), subtree (elements whose ctx_id equals the requested one or is nested under it). Ignored when ctx_id is absent.

filters._comment: Optional filter list. Each filter: { path (string — dot-separated semantic path into the element descriptor, e.g. 'functional.tags.domain'), op (string — case-insensitive, accepted values: EQ (exact text match), LIKE (SQL LIKE pattern with % wildcards), EXISTS (checks presence of the path regardless of value)), value (string or array of strings — required for EQ and LIKE, ignored for EXISTS), match (string: ANY|ALL — when value is an array: ANY=at least one matches, ALL=all must match; default ANY) }. Unknown or invalid filter entries are silently ignored. Example: [{ "path": "functional.tags.domain", "op": "EQ", "value": "audio" }, { "path": "functional.tags.status", "op": "EQ", "value": ["active", "experimental"], "match": "ANY" }, { "path": "objective.description", "op": "LIKE", "value": "%stream%" }, { "path": "brique.author", "op": "EXISTS" }]. All filters combine with AND.

limit._comment: Optional maximum number of results to return.

offset._comment: Optional zero-based result offset for pagination.

order_by._comment: Optional ordering. Accepted values: name (ascending by element name), kind (ascending by element_kind then name). Defaults to name.

result._comment: Matching projected elements. Each item: { element_kind (string — e.g. capacity, document, schema), name (string — element name within its context), ctx_id (string — absolute context path such as /root/workspace) }. The projection returns identity fields only; use read.meaning to retrieve full descriptor sections.

effects.projection_db: The root meaning projection database is queried read-only.

transformation_contract.morphing: A root meaning query becomes an ordered list of projected elements matching the requested filters, paging, and ordering.
invariants: meaning.query is root-only and runs against the derived projection database, never directly against descriptor files.
EXISTS selects elements by semantic path presence without requiring a value; it matches any indexed node at that path.
EQ selects elements by exact text value at the requested semantic path.
LIKE selects elements by SQL LIKE pattern (use % as wildcard) at the requested semantic path.

Array value paths are query-compatible: a filter on a container path also matches flattened values stored under that container, regardless of how many array levels the path traverses (e.g. a path through an array of objects that each hold another array) — supply the path without any array marker; the engine resolves it against every indexed array-bearing variant.
When filters[].value is an array, match=ANY selects elements matching at least one supplied value; match=ALL selects elements matching every supplied value.
Multiple filters in the list are combined with AND (all must match).
Supported order_by values are 'name' (default) and 'kind'. Default limit is 50 when absent.
ctx_mode=subtree matches ctx_id itself and any context nested under it (path prefix match); ctx_mode=strict (default) matches ctx_id exactly, with no nested contexts included.
success: On success, meaning.query returns an ordered result array of projected elements that match the requested filters and paging window.
Empty result sets are valid successful outcomes.
failure: The capacity is refused outside the root context.
The capacity fails when the projection database is unavailable or the query parameters cannot be translated into a valid projection query.
notes: meaning.query is for projected discovery and selection, not for returning full descriptor sections.
meaning.query addresses the complete meaning index. Paths omitted from the filtered global vocabulary, including objective.name and locator/control metadata, remain valid query filters.
Use read.meaning on the selected elements when detailed descriptor sections are required.
